thread:
jay: Quick heads-up — nightly demux probe flagged a perf regression on A100 for seqlen=1024 :eyes:
jay: numbers look like kernel selection picked demux_v2 instead of demux_v1 on the seqlen-dependent path
maria: ugh, saw that in the dashboard. Can you paste the microbench output?
jay: pasted below:
```
# microbench: kernel-demux-probe
arch=A100 seqlen=1024 batch=1
candidate=demux_v2 latency=12.4ms throughput=83 tok/s
baseline=demux_v1 latency=9.2ms throughput=110 tok/s
repro: python infra/bench/run_demux_probe.py --arch=a100 --seq=1024 --batch=1
```
linda: that 30% throughput drop is real. perf-ci-bot reported a 12% regression at service-level because it hit this path in the nightly replay :bug:
perf-ci-bot: nightly scan finished. regression detected: 12% @ seqlen=1024 (A100). affected routes: /stream/generate. trace: https://perf.redwood/internal/scan/9876
ops-carol: @linda any idea why demux_v2 was preferred? autotuner should prefer v1 for long seqs on this arch
linda: looks like autotune sampling weights were biased by short-seq synthetic workloads. demux_v2 is faster at seq<=256 but worse at >=512. our selector uses a weighted average and we didn't account for seq distribution skew in production
maria: can we change autotune to keep per-seqlen buckets rather than one global score? a quick patch in selector would reduce these flips
jay: agree. short-term: pin model route to demux_v1 for A100+seq>=512. I'll open a rollback PR and a canary for the change
maria: I'll add a KV-cache stress test to perf CI to ensure cache-friendly kernel picks. suspect demux_v2 thrashes KV cache for long prefix reuse
linda: also adding a microbenchmark harness job to nightly that sweeps seq=128,256,512,1024 across arch=A100,MI250 and reports kernel pick diffs
perf-ci-bot: created issue PERF-3281: "kernel selector: per-seqlen scoring + nightly sweep" (https://github.com/redwood/perf/issues/3281) :rocket:
ops-carol: timeline? we should avoid rolling deploy until we have the selector fix and a short-term pin
jay: rolling pin in next 30m. selector patch + test work tomorrow morning EST. I'll drop a small reproducer link to the thread: https://ci.redwood/repro/1798501234
maria: thanks — I'll own the CI harness changes and add explicit assertions that demux_v1 is chosen for seq>=512 on A100 in the perf regression job
linda: once CI lands, we can schedule a nightly sweep across instance types and collect pick histograms. want to catch similar issues for quantized kernels too
jay: sounds good. short notes: 1) rollback PR up in 10m 2) PERF-3281 tracks selector change 3) maria will add KV + per-seqlen harness 4) ops holds rollout until green :thumbsup:
perf-ci-bot: Note: next nightly will include the new microbench job after Maria's PR merges.
